usedFor: Process Street runs checklists, and Freshsales Classic updates a deal when “Workflow Run Completed” runs “Update Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “Workflow Run Completed” in Process Street, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A finished onboarding checklist can advance the deal's stage without a manual edit.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds the deal by ID or name, so the checklist must carry one of them.
